post.description: Enables agent-to-agent messaging using HCS-10/HCS-11 standards. Profile A sends evaluation message to Profile B via Hedera network, Profile B automatically responds. Uses official HCS-11 profiles and HCS-10 topics for messaging.

agentAId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of sender agent (must have HCS-11 profile and HCS-10 topics)

agentBId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of recipient agent (must have HCS-11 profile and HCS-10 topics)

candidateId.description: Identifier of the candidate being evaluated

message.description: Optional custom evaluation message. If not provided, AI will generate professional evaluation.
message.example: Please review this candidate's technical assessment results.
Based on my assessment, candidate John Doe demonstrates excellent interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence. I recommend proceeding with the next evaluation phase.

sentTo.description: Agent B's inbound topic ID where message was sent

message.example: Thank you for the soft skills evaluation. I acknowledge the positive assessment. Could you provide the specific numerical score for our records?

sentTo.description: Agent A's inbound topic ID where response was sent

networkMessages.description: Complete HCS-11 message structures sent via HCS-10

400.description: Bad request - Missing parameters or agents lack HCS-10 topics

error.example: Agent A (Sinda-SoftSkill-Agent) missing HCS-10 topics. Please initialize agent profiles first.
One or both agents not found
Failed to complete HCS-10/HCS-11 agent messaging
